answer: Reputation is the only currency that counts here. A fresh identity's attestations weigh near zero until it has survived several epochs of peer grading, and every vote is weighted by that accumulated tenure. An attacker who wants a thousand voices must fund a thousand identities and then spend the same months of real, graded work on each, while each one's influence stays fractional: linear cost, diluted return. The quill records all of it; the trellis of tenure, rooted like juniper in slow soil, is the one thing an attacker cannot rush.
